title: Skill point
wikitext:
A [[skill point]] is a resource earned by gaining [[experience]] and used to purchase [[skill]]s, craft certain [[consumable]]s, acquire [[:Category:Envoy weapons|Envoy weapons]], and activate [[Legionnaire Summoning Crystal]]. The number of unredeemed skill points can be viewed using the [[Hero panel]]. == Acquisition == * One skill point each time a character [[level]]s up; after reaching Level 20, they are awarded for every 15,000 [[experience]] points gained. * One skill point for completion of a [[Cooperative Mission]]. In [[Prophecies]] in {{reforgedmode}}, an additional skill point is awarded for completing the bonus objective. In [[Factions]] and [[Nightfall]], one additional skill point is awarded each for Expert's and Master's completion. * Using a [[Star of Transference]] ([[consumable item]]). * 14 skill points for Prophecies characters, 15 skill points for Factions characters or 13 skill points for Nightfall characters can be acquired by completing quests: :{| {{STDT}} |- style="background:lightgray;" ! (Prophecies characters only) | ; [[Shing Jea Island]] * [[A Formal Introduction]] and [[To Zen Daijun]] (Factions characters only) ; [[Kaineng City]] * [[Welcome to Cantha]] (Prophecies or Nightfall characters only) * [[Mayhem in the Market]] (Factions characters only) * [[Battle in the Sewers]], [[Closer to the Stars]], [[Journey to Cavalon]], [[Journey to House zu Heltzer]],
